verdict.rationale: Shopify documents agent-commerce endpoints for this story. Storefront MCP servers connect AI assistants to real-time commerce data from Shopify stores, and UCP lets agents search the Catalog and build carts and checkouts. A Cart MCP lets agents build and iterate on a cart, and a probe confirms the official MCP server documentation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the store endpoint, and the per-store endpoint details (URL, discovery mechanism) are thin in the cited snippets.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a shopping agent can discover my store's products and build carts through a documented agent-commerce endpoint on the store (MCP/UCP), not by scraping

citations.quote: Connect any AI assistant to real-time commerce data from Shopify stores with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
Build AI agents that authenticate with Shopify, search the Catalog, build carts and checkouts, and monitor orders using the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP).
enables AI agents to build and iterate on a cart before the buyer commits to purchase
enables AI agents to search and discover products across the entire Shopify ecosystem
official MCP server documented at https://shopify.dev/docs/agents
